response.overview: Living Colour is an 82-minute observational documentary film that explores the world of an unusual artists' collective in Callan, Co. Kilkenny, a studio which focuses on the artists' abilities instead of their special needs. As it takes us farther into their unique world, this extraordinary film builds into an often hilarious and intimate portrayal of a medley of charming and vibrant characters and throws up questions about the deeply human need to make art. Living Colour is a rich and rewarding cinema experience and is, in itself, a celebration of what it is to be human.
response.tagline: Shedding new light on outsider art
response.title: Living colour
